sentences.text:
. ... vs In Re: Rahiman
Nesa @ Rahima Khatoon on 21 February, 2023
21.02.2023 Sl. No.39 [Allowed] C. R. M. (Db) 687 of 2023 In Re: An application for bail under
Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on 09.02.2023 in connection with Banshihari
Police Station Case No.169 of 2022 dated 22.07.2022 under Sections 498A/306/34 of the Indian
Penal Code.

And In Re: Rahiman Nesa @ Rahima Khatoon ... ...
Petitioner Mr. Mazhar Hossain Chowdhury ... ... for the petitioner Mr. Debabrata Chatterjee .. ld.
Addl.
Public Prosecutor Ms. Moushumi Sarkar ... ... for the State Heard the learned Advocates appearing for both the parties.
We have considered the materials on record.
Petitioner is the mother-in-law of the victim lady.
Co-accuseds have been enlarged on bail.
Under such circumstances, we are of the opinion further detention of the accused/petitioner is not necessary.

Therefore, the accused/petitioner, namely Rahiman Nesa @ Rahima Khatoon, be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten thousand only), with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Gangarampur at Buniadpur, Dakshin Dinajpur subject to condition that the said petitioner shall appear before the trial court on every date of hearing until further orders and shall not intimidate witnesses or tamper with evidence in any manner whatsoever.
